items.description: After POST /api/adjustments with delta +5 on a (sku, location) at quantity 7, exactly one stock_records row exists for that pair carrying quantity 12, verified directly against the paired branch database scoped to the test's own per-run-unique pair
POST /api/adjustments with delta +5 on a uniquely-keyed (sku, location) at quantity 7, then GET /api/adjustments for the pair, returns exactly one audit record
The single audit record from a +5 delta on quantity 7 shows prior_quantity 7, new_quantity 12 (the resulting level, not the delta) and derived delta 5
The audit record from a delta adjustment shows the actor the caller entered and a server-stamped ISO-8601 UTC adjusted_at
POST /api/adjustments with delta 0 returns 422 naming the 'delta' field and GET /api/adjustments for the pair stays empty
POST /api/adjustments with a delta and an empty actor returns 422 naming the 'actor' field and writes no audit record
The delta preview component renders current quantity 7 and resulting quantity 12 for a +5 delta on a real stock record, exposed at the adjust-delta-preview seam
The delta preview component renders current quantity 7 and resulting quantity 4 for a -3 delta on a real stock record, exposed at the adjust-delta-preview seam

Playwright e2e at /adjust against the live DB: operator seeds a uniquely-keyed (crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku) record at quantity 7, switches adjust-mode-delta, enters +5 in field-delta and an actor in field-actor, submits via adjust-submit, sees adjust-success, and the SKU detail then shows quantity 12

Playwright e2e at /adjust against the live DB: operator on a uniquely-keyed (crypto.randomUUID()-suffixed sku) record at quantity 7 selects adjust-mode-delta, enters -3 in field-delta and an actor, submits via adjust-submit, sees adjust-success, and the SKU detail then shows quantity 4
